opening.tagline: Your intelligence. Your machine. Your rules.
opening.lede: Agent Guru runs on this computer. This setup looks at the machine, shows you what it would install and what it costs, and does nothing until you approve.
opening.requirements.body: Windows 10 or 11, Linux on x86-64, or macOS. 8 GB of RAM or more, and at least 25 GB of free disk for everything: setup shows the exact figure for this machine before it downloads anything. An NVIDIA GPU makes speech recognition faster but is not required.
opening.wake: Wake words: “Hey Guru” (हे गुरु) and “Hey Maya” (हे माया)
scan.title: Scanning this machine
scan.lede: Each row is a reading taken from this computer, shown as it comes in. Unknown means it could not be read, and why.
plan.title: Mission brief
plan.lede: This is everything setup would do. Change the parts, then approve.
plan.nothingelse: Nothing is added to PATH or the firewall.
plan.approve: I have read this plan and approve it
plan.cannot: This plan cannot be installed here:
install.title: Building Agent Guru
verify.title: Verification
verify.lede: Each part was checked for real. Checks that need you stay unverified until you answer.
online.title: Online
online.lede: Agent Guru is installed and every required part passed its check.
online.notready: Agent Guru cannot start yet: a required part did not pass.
ws.waiting: {n} waiting for this turn to finish
ws.q.typed: This window asked in turn {turn}. Your answer applies to this question only.
ws.q.spoken: Asked by voice in turn {turn}. A typed answer cannot confirm it.
ws.noreply: No reply came back. The log has the reason.
ws.owner.lede: Say Hey Guru or Hey Maya with nothing after it and you are greeted by this name.
ws.owner.label: Your name
tier.startup: Start with my computer and listen for Hey Guru (a tray icon shows it; turn it off in Control Center)
ws.studio.lede: Each control changes one setting. A restart of the assistant applies it.
ws.keys.lede: Off until you add one. Keys go into the encrypted store and are never shown again.
ws.control.lede: Install, repair or remove parts. These use the same engine as setup.
ws.control.none: This copy was not installed by setup, so there is nothing to manage here.
ws.doctor.lede: Runs every installed part's real check and says in plain words what is wrong.
